Rapid Response 47 (@RapidResponse47)

Before we ever proclaimed our independence, Americans carried within us the rarest of gifts: moral courage, and it came from a small but migh

Brilliantly done

Today I asked an abortion advocate what her favorite method of abortion is.

Joe Pug, folk artist, is a far more brilliant songwriter than the vast majority of the names on that list

This is an atrocious joke of a list for a bunch of reason, starting with the fact that it almost completely leaves out modern American folk and Americana, vibrant and eclectic genres where most of the best songwriting has always been done and is still being done


Daily Loud (@DailyLoud)

The New York Times published an unranked list of the 30 greatest living American songwriters

Controversial opinion, I know, but I think eleven Back to the Futures was a bit much. Could have stopped at like eight or so.
God forbid we ever have World War 3, Ilhan Omar will think we’re on World War One Hundred Eleven

Not enough people know about “Breakdown” with Kurt Russell. One of the most effective action thrillers ever made. On a short list of perfect movies. Not a single false note or bad beat. Tension builds. Delivers the payoff at the end. Movie over. How it’s supposed to be done.

Well there are only 53 people in the country and they’re all waiting in line for MAID anyway


Mithrandium (@LowOnIronMan)

I don’t deny Canada getting nuked, but the official casualty numbers are greatly exaggerated.



— https://nitter.net/LowOnIronMan/status/2048888766987743395#m

Yeah you got me. Everyone knows I’m really shy about having opinions on things. I never have takes. I’m notorious for having no takes. 

As for Canada, I insult it because that’s my solemn duty as an American. God forbid I should shirk from it.

Scholars still debate this but I tend to think the turning point came when both sides agreed to just nuke Canada instead


LucasPeri (@LucasPeri025)

In retrospect, what do you think was the turning point in WW9?



— https://nitter.net/LucasPeri025/status/2048886699187438072#m
Of course knowing my luck we’ll lose the 12th after winning 11 in a row
I’m skeptical of foreign intervention but if there’s already been eleven world wars then I think we might as well do one more and make it an even dozen. Eleven is just a weird number to end on.

Our founding fathers never even considered the possibility that illiterate third world women would one day be shipped into this country and then elected to congress. We are discovering a method of national suicide that never entered the minds of the founders.


TheBlaze (@theblaze)

Ilhan Omar gives a history lesson: “The last time the Alien Enemies Act was invoked it was used during World War ELEVEN.”

Video
  





— https://nitter.net/theblaze/status/2048865861373501747#m

Consider the astronomical levels of stupidity on display here. Ilhan Omar doesn’t know how to read Roman numerals AND she thinks there have been 11 world wars. Either one of those would be reasonable justification to remove her from office and send her back to Somalia. But both? My God.


AF Post (@AFpost)

Reading off of a card, Ilhan Omar mistakenly says that the last time the "Alien Enemies Act" was invoked was in "World War Eleven", confusing the Roman numerals for the number eleven.
